_note: Each scenario's seed was found by brute-force search: run newRun(seed) then a single direct springTrap/openChest/encounterDot call and keep the first seed whose result matches the scenario's target outcome (a sprung/damaging trap, an opened chest, a plain Table Four row, a Faerie encounter, and a Disease/Poison affliction). 'springTrap'/'openChest'/'encounterDot' are internal (non-validated) actions, mirroring action-script.combat.json's 'startCombat' precedent — the harness clones/rehydrates-rng/persists by hand, the same shape applyAction itself uses.
